⚡🇨🇳🇮🇷 China is challenging the United States and welcoming an Iranian aircraft on its territory.
A passenger plane from Mahan Air landed in Guangzhou, in southern China, despite the latest US sanctions targeting Iran's aviation sector.
Washington had warned that any foreign organization providing assistance to Iranian aircraft, including refueling or landing services, would face tough sanctions, potentially including exclusion from the dollar financial system. Beijing rejects these measures, calling them "illegal unilateral sanctions," and states that it will maintain its air and trade ties with Iran.

📑 Netanyahu orders ICC case prepared against Erdogan
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered an interministerial team and legal officials to prepare a case against Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan at the International Criminal Court, according to i24NEWS.
The case would target Türkiye's treatment of its Kurdish population, and allegations that Erdogan's government has financed Hamas.
Neither Israel nor Türkiye is a party to the Rome Statute — neither recognizes the ICC's jurisdiction. Sources say Israel hopes to use the proceedings as leverage against Erdogan rather than necessarily filing.
The ICC has issued arrest warrants for Israeli officials over the war in Gaza. The man ordering this case would be arrested on sight in most of Europe. And he's now trying to file paperwork at the court that wants him in a cell.
The ICC has been repeatedly accused of devolving into a[ corruption-steeped political weapon](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/49077), doling out "justice" on a pay-to-play basis, selectively targeting nations who champion multipolarity—those forging independent paths with Russia, China, or others outside Western orbits.
